files.assessment: Exact node identities/counts, cycle/self-loop/external and missing endpoints, diagnostics and adapter results constrain synthetic fixtures. Repeated-call equality tests determinism; it is supplemented by independent expectations. These are fixture contracts, not graph UI or runtime dependency semantics.

Trusted subscription observations keep the generation; switching to API-key rotates it; unknown invalidates with untrusted_lifecycle; rebound differs from both previous values; stopped clears. Named owner is actually stopped/recreated and same-mode observation gets a new generation. This is owner restart coverage, not full daemon restart.

Private owner/store with fixed clock, via support helper. Malformed account-mode/header payload retains same-generation 83% as stale and a valid 42% update recovers. Valid mode change rotates and removes old window facts; unknown classification clears generation/windows. Cross-provider writes leave Claude snapshot unchanged. Injected rejection/failure-recorder errors are surfaced. Exact redacted-message shape excludes correlations; no live provider request.

Actual cat ports and recorded StreamDiagnostics exercise direct turn/failed handling. Structured rate limits and diagnostic session-limit text pause; unrelated diagnostic remains error. Ports have on_exit cleanup in addition to success cleanup. This is handler classification, not scheduler pause/resume or provider execution.

Workflow-backed accessor checks nil model, explicit model, default command, permission defaults, valid acceptEdits and invalid-value fallback to bypassPermissions. Preserve or explicitly reconsider permissive fallback in the package contract; tests characterize configuration, not authorization enforcement.

Synthetic JSONL with real supervised tailer and manual polls tests history backfill, session retargeting, missing-path recovery, killed inner-tailer health with opaque logging, malformed-line skip and explicit backfill/live ingress. Cold-start operator request IDs deduplicate then flush to exact session; unresolved buffer retains newest 32 of 40. Owner process exit is monitored to normal tailer DOWN. Body cap requires truncation marker and <2000 bytes for max_body 1000, not an exact bound. Display callbacks do not prove TUI rendering. First test says in order but assertions only check role/body membership; isolated extracted-assertion probe confirms the local gap in tests-4-cont-01.

Lifecycle/unknown normalization, optional fields and nonbinary-to-nil cases, actual subscribed dispatch and per-identifier exclusion. Malformed dispatch returns ok. Does not exercise HTTP ingress or a running Claude hook.

Restores injected dashboard URL provider; exact set of four hook names; endpoint sampled from StopFailure. Shell-command substring checks require timeout/silencing/header/exit suffix and normalized slash; does not execute curl or prove wall-clock bound/exit behavior. Write test decodes actual JSON and cleans generated path.

Structured and textual limit classifications have negative ordinary-crash/stack-line-429 controls. Prose reset extraction, structured reset priority, timezone-resolved provider refusal, missing reset nil, 404/529 and banner-without-provider-provenance rejection are explicit. These finite fixtures are not exhaustive language parsing or current provider protocol validation.

Pinned fixture normalization carries provider/backend/source/version and reported quota only. Unknown status with quota/reset omitted stays unknown and absent, not zero. Reconciler refresh at reset+1 makes health/window stale. Concrete drift/range/unknown-field and legacy/OTel rejection cases, plus fixture forbidden-substring checks. Test title every non-allowlisted field is broader than finite examples; do not report exhaustive privacy proof.

Real adapter ports talk to scripted shell app-servers. Workspace/base/telemetry env, model override, dynamic tool advertisement, invocation identity, tool replies and 110KiB spill file round-trip are asserted. Two sessions coexist but turns run sequentially; the shared frame check sorts model values, not per-session identity. Closed port and exit-1 failures remain clean errors. Meter ingestion and redacted callbacks are injected. Provider refusal pauses preserve retry counts, record reset (including controlled atomic-rename failure), respect global/label/operator holds, and resume at reset through direct reconcile; entry lacks a generation and expects legacy two-tuple resume. Later unrelated crashes, stale/quoted/tool banners and assistant-only banner do not inherit quota classification. No actual Claude service, full controller run or rendered UI exercised.

Mixes real OS and injected boundaries: live BEAM procfs identity, actual sleep process-group pidfd reap, trap-installed readiness before delayed TERM wait, real distinct child found through pgrep, and group cleanup after leader exits. Identity-change barrier uses injected reaper, not a real PID-reuse race. Private trust JSON preserves sibling keys. Fake procfs with injected kill tests strict descendant cwd, protected self tree, shallow-root refusal, later-appearing process resweep and bounded exhausted warning. real_proc scenario uses real procfs and inside/outside sleepers, not launcher stop end-to-end. Its cwd wait exhausts as ok and inside sleeper lacks fallback cleanup if reap fails; retain as failure-path hygiene candidate, not proven leak. No real RC service attachment.

Mostly shell-text construction checks: success chain, credential scrub before exec, configured base quoting, flag order and absent optional flags. Failed-workspace case actually runs bash with stub claude and requires nonzero/no launch/no token output; successful launch credential removal is not exercised here. Resume ID requires private transcript existence. Hook-settings environment-dependent case accepts nil or binary and only constrains nonraising return shape.

Tmux mock command/reply handshake tests readiness timeout cleanup, failure retention when pane kill fails, successful non-RC session metadata and both ProcessReaper registrations, unavailable RC attach cleanup, and missing hook listener rejected before any tmux output. Fabricated teardown PIDs have host probes/signals stubbed in failure cases. Readiness/RC remain injected pane text; no live tmux/Claude. Serial application-env override is restored by put_env (absent becomes nil). receive_barrier and Task.await infinity do not provide a local bounded failure deadline.

Mock paste/pane/interrupt plus actual HookEvents dispatch. Successful Ctrl+C returns correlated pause request; failed interrupt returns error, not paused. Silent timeout, repeated heartbeat extension, provider-hook-only delivery acknowledgement, raw session ID versus synthetic display fallback, structured StopFailure quota versus ordinary auth failure/assistant prose preserved. Heartbeat timing uses wall-clock sleeps; helper drain recursion has no overall local deadline. No HTTP hook transport, provider or UI verification.

Mock literal send-keys followed by Enter; newline/control sanitization, all-control empty/no send, invalid payload/session, Ctrl+C, immediate success callback and missing-tmux failure callback, noop. A success request ID demonstrates transport command completion, not provider acceptance or persisted delivery. Sanitization sample asserts no newline and matching printable text but does not exhaustively inspect every control byte.

Preserve distinct submission contracts: hook/RC path never clears input and sends Enter best-effort even after echo timeout; transcript path clears/retypes missing echo and returns prompt_not_delivered without Enter on timeout. Mock command response sequencing drives actual function paths; paste chip/prefix are fabricated observations. Drain rejects unexpected clear commands until completion marker; not manual TUI testing.

Mock banner immediate URL and footer-driven /rc, Enter, dialog scrape then Escape. Timeout still dismisses dialog and yields nil; no evidence at zero budget nil. These characterize text/command protocol, not real service availability; fixed captured/fabricated strings may drift independently.

Callback envelope preserves event/session/thread/turn details, DateTime timestamp, and nested transcript without flattening type. Title says merges event/timestamp over details but supplied details contain no colliding event/timestamp; exact overwrite precedence is not constrained by these fixtures.

Mock pane lookup plus injected group liveness/cleanup tests cleanup_proven only after group/pane absence, observed disappearance overriding raced signal error, and distinct pane_still_alive/process_group_still_alive errors. Invalid session is a no-op. High fabricated PIDs exercise already-gone path, not real kill. Own-pane test contains another-owner negative control; orphan test alone has only dead owner, supplemented by ReplAgent wrapper live-owner/unrelated-window controls. No actual tmux or provider teardown.

Mock tmux plus actual temporary JSONL/tailer: missing cold transcript returns no_transcript; warm completion and prompt-record callback correlate turn identity; structured API error versus assistant quota prose remain distinct. Pause without appended terminal record returns pause_confirmation_timeout. Warm-from-end fixture starts empty, so its title alone does not prove historical completion exclusion (TranscriptTailer has separate explicit prehistory test). Pump/drain helpers lack an overall local deadline.

Wrapper integration over mocked tmux, private transcripts and HookEvents. Resume requires file existence and omitted handle stays clean; RC/resume flags and attach text are simulated, not live CLI acceptance. Dead/live/unrelated owner sweep controls supplement Reaper tests. Sequential turns preserve thread and change turn IDs without new-window. Cold-start materialization, missing echo/retype, timeout/gone pane, deliver-now versus checkpoint queue signals, exact control-byte sanitization and single Enter are covered. Transcript pause requires terminal evidence; failed interrupt and no terminal remain errors. Hook path emits control completion but not assistant/tool display events, and never clears/retypes. Many drains use no overall local deadline; some minimal send/interrupt/empty fixtures create transcripts without individual cleanup. Older readiness-failure helper supplies PID5050 without the newer Launcher test's explicit host cleanup stubs: inspect production containment identity before executing this test. No UI verification.

Explicit midnight/noon next-day rollover, reset-date DST gap/overlap, timestamp normalization, invalid/zoneless unknown, and repeatedly expired explicit deadlines stay nil. These are deterministic time-policy contracts, not actual provider wake execution.

Real private file and supervised tailer with manual polls: partial trailing line deferred, skip nonconversation, incremental non-reemit, attach cutoff including initially partial record stays backfill, shorter-file replacement restarts reading. Distinct terminal assistant/API/system/result error callbacks, retryable api_retry and tool_use do not terminate. Explicit from:end prehistory then append test constrains historical exclusion. Replacement fixture only shrinks same path; does not establish same/larger-size inode rotation. Cloud-authored test is identical synthetic local file shape, not phone transport. Selective event then turn_end receives do not prove callback order.

Notification/disk conversion preserves roles, provider/fallback turn IDs, tool output/diff/title, skips progress/control and empty records, passes pre-extracted event unchanged. DeltaRenderer path actually generates expected diff fences and markers, but no terminal rendering. Multi-block disk fixture asserts ordered roles assistant then command; stable record/block identity distinguishes equal bodies and replays same IDs. Queued prompt attachment becomes user row while slash/control records skipped. Lower-level ordered extraction does not constrain DisplayTailer callback forwarding order.

Exact Decimal cost and additive token dimensions are reconciled against an independent sum in 50 generated cases. Request retry identity ignores source sequence changes but changes with trusted attempt/worker/producer or run; missing request uses session sequence. Missing cost/cache/time stays nil with ordered coverage reasons. Unsupported source/relationship/identity/backend fail bounded, per-request model/effort survive, prompt/capability do not. Pure adapter inputs assume trusted correlation; authentication is tested in Telemetry separately.

Serial persistent-term cache reset plus private credential fixtures and injected request callbacks. Worst usable allowed window, above-100 clamp, invalid/negative rejection, weekly-first ordering, absent supported weekly nil versus omitted optional window. Distinct missing/malformed/empty/expired credentials; valid token delivery to callback; HTTP 429/auth/other/transport/raising callback outcomes. Counters prove cache hit, TTL expiry, uncached other errors and reset; 429 retains prior reading during backoff without request. No actual remote HTTP and no measured production quota saving. Expired-token test calls token reader, whereas missing-credential fetch explicitly spies no request; retained reading test does not assert stale age/health presentation.

Named supervised receiver with real listener; most submit calls invoke Receiver.call via Plug.Test, while partial-body test makes a real loopback TCP request and observes408. Pinned fixture exact Decimal/tokens, trusted correlation, bounded subagent categorization, nil optional coverage, headless/replay/stale-session/cross-ticket exclusion, version/field grammar and content allowlists, auth-before-malformed-body with log redaction, bounds and recovery all asserted. Held authorization demonstrates concurrent gate; full rate capacity rejects malformed body before decode. Replacement/revoke and late release cannot revive old capability. One acceptor-supervisor child is structural evidence, not direct maximum-socket concurrency proof. Model test suppresses unchanged model but does not supply a changed model. Deterministic capability collision refuses new launch but does not then exercise original token. Status redaction assertion searches full Bearer value, not separately bare token. No provider-generated traffic or UI.

Real private owners/stores, fixed mint/clock, direct adapter calls. Unlike Claude observe same-mode continuity, Codex same-mode account update rotates absent explicit proof; token refresh/quota do not rotate. Distinct absent/logout/unsupported/untrusted/teardown reasons, canonical last-good health and recovery, keyed multi-limit protection and compatibility observer exclusion after malformed/lost continuity preserved. Separate compatibility file cannot overwrite canonical store. Copied session cannot rebind after teardown; actual owner stop/recreate retains topic and fresh generation, outage-created binding needs original authority. Finite sequence enumeration checks refresh equality and repeated-auth generation change, but generic nil-or-binary assertion alone does not constrain logout/unsupported/teardown after every prefix; individual examples cover those cases. First startup privacy test declares raw identity without supplying it; notification privacy fixture does supply it. No live account/provider or daemon restart.

Real cat ports inspect protocol frames, injected executors and real ToolCallLedger. Modern/legacy approval decision strings, approval-required refusal, stable callId, paused command decline/tool nonexecution/idless notification pass-through. Closed-port replay returns stored result with exactly one execution; different thread same call executes separately; conflicting payload fails with execution count unchanged. These are sequential in-process replay checks, not durable restart or concurrent execution proof. User-input approval checks exact answer; noninteractive fallback checks only map plus event, not answer content. Port cleanup uses after.

Actual private directories/symlinks test canonical workspace containment and root/outside/escape distinctions; remote empty/control strings rejected. Command model/effort quoting exact string; metadata cat-port presence and remote-host omission. Conditional setsid path starts real adapter process and requires group/root identity, cleans in after; absent setsid takes assert true rather than proving containment. Already-closed port stop safe. No SSH execution.

Schema default is constrained to a valid string enum and legacy map rejected; explicit variants including never accepted, trimming and invalid-message hints checked. Comment says default must be non-never, but allowed set includes never and no exclusion assertion exists. Record as local oracle mismatch pending intended-policy/source and overlapping tests, not a proven current policy defect.

Real shell parent/child teardown with pgrep readiness and owner-outage port cleanup; not an actual Codex database-lock scenario. Pure start/resume frame policies, dynamic-tools omitted on resume, matching thread genuine versus substituted fresh, invalid response and error fallback preserved. Delayed shell response exercises startup floor past steady timeout. Real shell fixture sends pre-turn quota notification and current callback gets redacted notification; closed-port handshake yields error. Fresh-frame dynamicTools assertion only is_list, supplemented elsewhere by exact tool tests. No live Codex service or UI.

scope_note: Source review with an isolated extracted-assertion order probe; no production edits, full suite, live provider or manual UI verification. Supporting claude_meter_test_support.exs read separately and not counted in this unit.

findings.title: Display-forwarding order test accepts a reversed conversation
findings.description: The test promises a full conversation in order, but all ten content assertions check membership in the role or event lists. A reversal retains every member and passes. The poll count lower bound also cannot constrain order.
findings.evidence: tooling/display_tailer_order_oracle_probe.exs extracts the ten actual membership assertions from the named test AST. Both ordered and reversed six-event conversations pass; an exact-order control accepts the original and rejects its reversal. Probe exits zero with four explicit results.
findings.recommendation: Assert the ordered role/body sequence forwarded by DisplayTailer, then verify reversing the forwarding order makes the guard fail. Keep partial/backfill/live tests separate.
findings.refactor_hint: An ordered stream boundary needs ordered output assertions rather than set membership or selective receives.
findings.limits: Oracle-only probe with supplied events; no application, provider or production mutation. Transcript.extract_disk_record already has a two-role ordering assertion, but that lower boundary does not prove display forwarding order. No current production reordering defect is alleged. Cross-unit deduplication remains pending.
